name: Eldrazi Conscription
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +10/+10 and has trample and annihilator 2. (Whenever it attacks, defending player sacrifices two permanents of their choice.)
blocked_sentences: Enchanted creature gets +10/+10 and has trample and annihilator 2. (Whenever it attacks, defending player sacrifices two permanents of their choice.)

needs.what: the parameterised keyword Annihilator N (702.86): a triggered ability 'Whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices N permanents of their choice', grantable by a static grant_keyword with its N (here an Aura's affects: {attached: true} granting annihilator 2)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: annihilator is not in the packet's keywords list, so grant_keyword cannot hand it out. The nearest workaround -- a grant_ability static carrying a grantable 'attacks' triggered ability with a sacrifice op (the Bear Umbra shape) -- would give the creature an unnamed trigger rather than the keyword, would not stack or count as annihilator, and has no shown way to bind 'defending player' as the sacrificing chooser; the brief forbids that substitution

needs.what: the card type Kindred (formerly Tribal, 308): the type line 'Kindred Enchantment — Eldrazi Aura' lets a noncreature card carry the creature subtype Eldrazi
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the packet's types list (Artifact, Battle, Creature, Enchantment, Instant, Land, Planeswalker, Sorcery) has no Kindred, so the card could only be typed as a plain Enchantment and the Eldrazi subtype would be unexplained to anything reading creature types
